A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Aux-Think and R2R-CoT-320k. Their main text, equations, figures, tables and appendices are readable and support reliable matching, including relocated material.

before.justification: v3 reports original navigation evaluations, component and reasoning ablations, cross-dataset results, and supplementary reinforcement-learning findings.

after.justification: v4 retains original navigation and ablation results and reports additional component configurations in Table 4.

M1.justification: Aux-Think retains the same model, auxiliary reasoning tasks, losses, prompt switching and receding-horizon action procedure. The deleted GRPO trials were supplementary experiments, not components of the proposed Aux-Think procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use R2R-CE, RxR-CE, R2R-CoT-320k and the same additional training sources. The RxR evaluation without RxR training remains in Appendix A.1; no dataset, domain or navigation scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: v4 removes Open-Nav-Llama3.1 from the R2R comparison in Table 1 and BEVBert from the RxR comparison in Table 2. BEVBert remains in Table 1, and the other comparator memberships, including Appendix Table 6, are unchanged.

E3.justification: Table 4 adds an instruction-only control and explicitly reports a planning-only configuration, whose prediction horizon is unspecified. Retained benchmark and SFT settings are unchanged, while the reported GRPO protocols in v3 Appendix A.4 disappear.

E4.justification: Table 4 extends the cumulative component ablation with standalone instruction-reasoning and planning rows; planning-horizon sensitivity already existed in Table 5. v4 removes the GRPO failure, exploration and convergence analyses from v3 Appendix A.4. The reasoning-weight, trajectory-length and navigation-case analyses remain.

E5.justification: Neither version supplies repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars or statistical tests. v4's checklist answers Yes to statistical-significance reporting, but its reference to Section 4 supplies no additional statistical evidence or procedure.

E6.justification: Table 4 adds instruction-only results of SR 40.6 and SPL 35.7, and planning-only results of SR 37.1 and SPL 32.2. Two baseline result rows and the GRPO findings are removed. Retained benchmark scores and Tables 3, 5, 6 and 7 are unchanged; no headline performance gain is reported.

T1.justification: The mathematical formulation and training objectives in Equations 1–5 are unchanged apart from formatting. No theorem, proof or substantive derivation is added or removed.

C1.justification: The three central contributions—reasoning-collapse findings, auxiliary reasoning supervision and R2R-CoT-320k—retain their meaning and scope. Inference-time Reasoning Collapse becomes Test-time Reasoning Collapse; the data-efficiency and success-rate claims remain equivalent.

C2.justification: The introduction newly argues that DAgger still provides limited off-distribution coverage and leaves CoT supervision biased toward optimal states. Conversely, v4 removes the explanations of unsuccessful RL refinement and the corresponding limitation and lightweight-model future direction from Section 5.

D1.justification: Checklist item 16 newly states that CoT annotations received human supervision, manual review and curation, without detailing that process or establishing a dataset change. Removing the GRPO appendix also removes initialization and compute information, including 600 steps in 48 hours. Main SFT settings, prompts and the project link remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v4 adds citations to MambaVO and MonoDream and removes Open-Nav, SmolVLM and DeepSeekMath. These are limited changes to contextual references and removed experimental discussion; the central positioning against direct-action navigation and explicit reasoning remains intact.

P1.justification: v4 edits the abstract and selected passages, replaces inference-time/IRC terminology with test-time/TRC, and updates author and conference information. It adds acknowledgements and a conference checklist and renumbers the remaining appendix after deleting the RL section. Most scientific prose and the main section sequence remain intact.

P2.justification: The visual explanation is substantially expanded: the small strategy schematic becomes a detailed four-strategy overview including Aux-Think, and a dataset-annotation pipeline figure is added. Figure 1 moves before the abstract, the reasoning-weight chart becomes a separate wrapped figure, and Table 4 expands. Existing case-study and dataset-statistics figures are retained and relocated.

improvement.justification: The expanded diagrams and standalone instruction ablation improve clarity and component attribution. However, v4 removes the RL failure/compute discussion and two comparator rows, while its new planning-only row lacks the horizon information needed to reconcile it with Table 5. The checklist also asserts statistical-significance reporting without supporting statistics. These benefits and losses prevent a reliable judgment of net overall improvement.
